texts.DefaultNosHelp: Numbers are assigned automatically when the number is left blank.
texts.ManualNosHelp: People may type their own number instead of taking the next one.
texts.DateOrderHelp: Numbers must be assigned in date order. Required for posted invoices in some countries.
texts.NoSeriesLinesHelp: The line whose starting date is closest to the posting date is used, so a new line can start each year. Last no. used is kept by the system.

texts.DocumentNumberingHelp: Which number series each kind of record draws from. Leave a field on "numbered by hand" to type numbers yourself.
texts.DocumentNoHelp: Leave blank to take the next number of the series.
texts.WorkflowsHelp: An enabled workflow makes documents of its kind need approval before they can be released or posted. Disable a workflow to change it.
texts.MinimumAmountHelp: Documents below this amount are released without approval. Zero means every document needs approval.
texts.DueDaysHelp: Days an approver has to respond. Zero means no due date.
texts.ApproverLimitTypeHelp: Approver chain: everyone up the chain until someone's limit covers the amount. Direct approver: only the sender's own approver. First qualified approver: only the first person whose limit covers it.
texts.EnableWorkflowConfirmation: Once enabled, documents of this kind will need approval before they can be released or posted. Continue?
texts.WorkflowDefaultsRestored: Workflow steps reset to the default template.
texts.ApprovalUserSetupHelp: Who approves each person's requests, and up to what amount they may approve themselves. A request travels up this chain.
texts.SubstituteHelp: Who takes over when a request is delegated.
texts.ApprovalAdministratorHelp: May act on any approval request, whoever it is addressed to.
texts.RejectHelp: The document goes back to its sender, who can change it and ask again.
texts.DelegateHelp: Hand the request to this approver's substitute.
texts.DelegateConfirmation: The request will be handed to the approver's substitute. Continue?
texts.ApprovalAutoApproved: Within your own approval limit: the document was released.
texts.ApprovalRequestCanceled: The approval request was canceled and the document reopened.

texts.ModuleDescription:Core: Companies, dimensions and number series. Everything else is addressed by these, so they are always on.
texts.ModuleDescription:Finance: Chart of accounts, general journals, posting and G/L registers. The ledger every other module writes to.
texts.ModuleDescription:Sales: Customers, sales invoices and the receivables ledger.
texts.ModuleDescription:Purchasing: Vendors, purchase invoices and the payables ledger.
texts.ModuleDescription:Inventory: Items, categories, units of measure and the item ledger.
texts.ModuleDescription:Reporting: Trial balance, statements, aged analyses, account schedules and report layouts.
texts.ModuleDescription:Approvals: Approval workflows, approvers and the requests waiting on them.
texts.ModuleDescription:Integration: Published web services and outbound webhooks for other systems.
texts.ModuleDescription:DataExport: Exporting any table to CSV, Excel or JSON.
texts.ModuleDescription:Chatter: Notes, activity history and follow-up tasks on any record.
texts.ModuleDescription:Kanban: Pipeline boards for documents that move through stages.
texts.ModulesDescription: Turn parts of the system on and off for this company. A module that is off disappears from the menu and its API stops answering; its data is kept and comes back untouched when you turn it on again.
texts.ModuleWillBeSwitchedOff: {0} will be switched off for this company. Its screens disappear and its API stops answering. Its data is kept, and comes back if you switch it on again.
texts.NothingNeedsAttention: Nothing needs your attention right now.

texts.LongWelcomeMessage: Sign in to see what needs your attention today.
texts.ThemeDescription: How the app looks for everyone in this organisation: colours, top bar and corners. Changes show straight away and are kept once saved.
texts.ThemePreviewing: You are previewing unsaved changes. Save to keep them, or leave the page to go back.
texts.Theme:primaryColorHint: The top bar and app headings.
texts.Theme:accentColorHint: Buttons, links and the activity tiles.
texts.ThemeReset: The theme is back to the default.
texts.CopyCompanyDescription: Creates a new company set up like {0}: chart of accounts, dimensions and posting setup.
texts.ReportLayoutsDescription: Change how a report looks when it is printed. Start from the built-in layout, edit it, and make it the one this company uses.
texts.LayoutPlaceholdersHint: {{Title}}, {{CompanyName}}, {{FromDate}}, {{ToDate}}, {{PrintedOn}}; repeat with {{#Columns}}{{Header}}{{/Columns}} and {{#Rows}}{{#Cells}}{{Value}}{{/Cells}}{{/Rows}}. A row also offers {{RowClass}}, {{Indent}} and {{Cell:key}}.
texts.ExcludedFieldsHint: Separated by commas. Withheld fields cannot be read, filtered or sorted by.

texts.Profile:BUSINESS_MANAGER:Description: Runs the company day to day: customers, vendors, cash, approvals and the figures.
texts.Profile:ACCOUNTANT:Description: Keeps the books: journals, ledgers, VAT, period end and financial reports.
texts.Profile:SALES_ORDER_PROCESSOR:Descriptio: Takes orders and invoices customers, with the items they buy.
texts.Profile:PURCHASING_AGENT:Description: Buys from vendors and keeps the items and their purchase invoices.
texts.Profile:HR_MANAGER:Description: Looks after employees, their absences, contracts and expense payouts.
texts.Profile:ADMINISTRATOR:Description: Sets the system up: modules, numbering, posting setup, approvals and integrations.
texts.ProfilesHelp: A user works as the profile they picked under My role. Otherwise they get the profile of the first of their roles assigned one below (in the order the profiles are listed), and otherwise Business Manager. A profile only decides which links the navigation bar shows; permissions still decide what a user can open.

texts.AllocateInterestConfirmation: Every member's fund will be credited with the declared interest. This cannot be undone.
texts.ContributionPeriodHelp: Any day of the month the contributions are for.
texts.DateOfCalculationHelp: The benefit counts entries posted on or before this date. Blank uses the exit date.
texts.EmployerPortionPctHelp: The share of the employer's money the member has earned the right to; the rest stays in the scheme.
texts.NoOfDaysInAYear: No. of Days in a Year
texts.PensionSetupHelp: Schemes are values of the scheme dimension, so every scheme of the administrator is kept in this company and any report can be filtered to one.
texts.PostContributionConfirmation: The schedule will be posted to the members' funds and the general ledger.
texts.PostExitConfirmation: The member will be paid out: the benefit leaves the member's fund and becomes payable.
texts.SchemeDimensionHelp: Each pension scheme becomes a value of this dimension, and every entry a scheme posts carries it.
texts.SponsorCustomerHelp: Contributions are charged to this customer's account. Blank posts them to the accrual account.
texts.TaxRatePctHelp: Tax withheld from interest on unregistered money, as a percentage of that interest.
texts.UpperLimitHelp: Zero means the band has no upper limit.

texts.ModuleDescription:Academics: Admissions, students, semester registration, fee billing through customer accounts, exam results and grading.
texts.Permission:Erp:Academics:Post: Admit Students, Submit Registrations, Post Bills and Results
texts.Erp:Academics:00002: The end date of {code} is before its start date.
texts.Erp:Academics:00003: Grade {grade} must run from a lower to a higher mark and must not overlap another grade of its exam category.
texts.Erp:Academics:00004: The {examType} part needs a maximum score above zero, and the parts of an exam category cannot contribute more than 100% together.
texts.Erp:Academics:00005: The minimum of {code} cannot be above its maximum, and neither can be negative.
texts.Erp:Academics:00006: Unit {unit} cannot be its own prerequisite.
texts.Erp:Academics:00007: Application {applicationNo} is {status}, so this cannot be done.

texts.Erp:Academics:00011: There is nothing to post for {documentNo}.
texts.Erp:Academics:00012: Student {studentNo} cannot register or be marked: the student is {status}.
texts.Erp:Academics:00013: Registration for semester {semester} is not open on this date.
texts.Erp:Academics:00014: Student {studentNo} cannot register before clearing a fee balance of {balance}.
texts.Erp:Academics:00015: {documentNo} has no units. Add the units the student is taking first.
texts.Erp:Academics:00016: A registration for stage {stage} takes between {minimum} and {maximum} units (0 is no limit).
texts.Erp:Academics:00017: Student {studentNo} already took unit {unit} on {documentNo}. Register for a retake or a supplementary instead.
texts.Erp:Academics:00018: Unit {unit} can be taken only after passing {prerequisite}.
texts.Erp:Academics:00019: Results entry is blocked for exam category {category}.
texts.Erp:Academics:00020: Exam category {category} has no {examType} part. Add it under Exam Components first.
texts.Erp:Academics:00021: Student {studentNo} appears more than once on {documentNo}.
texts.Erp:Academics:00022: Student {studentNo} has no submitted registration for unit {unit} in semester {semester}.
texts.Erp:Academics:00023: Student {studentNo} already has a {examType} mark for unit {unit}.
texts.Erp:Academics:00024: The mark of student {studentNo} ({mark}) is above the maximum score of {maximum}.
texts.Erp:Academics:00025: {table} {code} is in use, so it cannot be deleted or renamed.
texts.Erp:Academics:00026: Unit {unit} is not on offer in programme {programme}.
texts.Erp:Academics:00027: {documentNo} has lines. Delete them before changing what it is for.
texts.AcademicSetupHelp: A student has a customer account under the same number. Fees are charged to it, so what a student owes is the balance of that account and a fee payment is an ordinary receipt.
texts.CurrentPeriodHelp: Documents created without one take the current one. Marking this one current takes the mark off the other.
texts.RegistrationDatesHelp: Students can register for the semester between these dates. Blank leaves registration open.
texts.GradeRemarksHelp: What a result slip says against the grade, for example Distinction.
texts.MaxScoreHelp: What the part is marked out of.
texts.ContributionPctHelp: The share of the final score this part contributes. The parts of a category add up to 100.
texts.ProgrammeExamCategoryHelp: The grading scheme the programme is examined under. Results cannot be posted without one.
texts.ProgrammeStudentNosHelp: A number series of its own for the students of the programme. Blank uses the Academic Setup series.
texts.StageSequenceHelp: The position of the stage in the programme; the first stage has the lowest.
texts.UnitLimitsHelp: The fewest and the most units a student may register for in a semester of the stage. Zero is no limit.
texts.UnitSemesterHelp: Blank teaches the unit in every semester of its stage.
texts.PrerequisiteHelp: A unit of the same programme that must be passed before this one is taken.
texts.FeeDefaultAmountHelp: What a bill line for the item starts with when it is added by hand.
texts.FeeSemesterHelp: Blank charges the fee in every semester of the stage.
texts.FeeStudyModeHelp: (all) charges the fee whatever the mode of study.
texts.AdmitStudentConfirmation: The applicant becomes a student with a student number and a customer account. This cannot be undone.
texts.RejectApplicationConfirmation: The application will be rejected. It can be reopened later.
texts.SubmitRegistrationConfirmation: The student is registered for the semester and billed its fees. A submitted registration cannot be changed.
texts.BillStageHelp: Blank takes the stage the student is in. Suggest Fees reads the fee structure of this stage.
texts.BillLineDescriptionHelp: Blank takes the description of the fee item.
texts.PostStudentBillConfirmation: The bill will be posted to the student's account and the fee income accounts.
texts.PostExamResultConfirmation: The marks will be assigned to the students' units and graded. Posted results cannot be changed.
texts.MarkHelp: Out of the maximum score of the exam component.
texts.NotDoneHelp: The student did not sit the assessment: no mark is assigned and the unit stays ungraded.
texts.BillOnRegistrationHelp: Submitting a registration raises and posts a bill from the fee structure of its stage and semester.
texts.MaxFeeBalanceToRegisterHelp: With the check on, a student owing more than this cannot register.
texts.ExamRoundingDecimalsHelp: Final scores are rounded to this many decimals before they are graded.
texts.StudentPostingGroupHelp: The posting groups a student's customer account is opened with on admission.

texts.Erp:CashManagement:00012: The deductions come to more than the amount of {amount}.
texts.Erp:CashManagement:00013: Deduction code {code} has no payable account.

texts.Erp:Pensions:00023: The pensions of scheme {scheme} for {period} were already posted with {documentNo}.
texts.Erp:Pensions:00024: Pensioner {pensionerNo} appears more than once on {documentNo}.

texts.Erp:Pensions:00026: Pensioner {pensionerNo} has been paid on a pension payroll.
texts.CashManagementSetupHelp: Payment vouchers are numbered from this series, including the ones other documents raise: fee refunds, exit benefits and pension payrolls.
texts.PaymentTypeHelp: Fills in the account, the VAT rate and the deductions that payments of this kind normally carry.
texts.PayableAccountHelp: The liability account what is withheld is owed on.
texts.ChequeHelp: The cheque or transfer reference. It can be filled in until the voucher is posted.
texts.AppliesToDocNoHelp: The invoice of the vendor, customer or employee this amount settles.
texts.GrossAmountHelp: The gross amount, VAT included. Deductions are worked out on the amount without VAT.
texts.PostPaymentVoucherConfirmation: The voucher will be paid: the net amount leaves the bank account. This cannot be undone.
texts.RaisePaymentVoucherConfirmation: A payment voucher will be raised for the net amount. It is then approved and paid under Payment Vouchers.
texts.ReceiptReferenceHelp: The deposit slip, cheque or mobile money transaction number.
texts.AppliesToBillHelp: The bill the receipt settles. Blank leaves the amount on the student account as a prepayment, which the next bill is charged against.
texts.PostStudentReceiptConfirmation: The receipt will be posted to the bank account and the student account.
texts.ApproveRefundConfirmation: A payment voucher will be raised for the refund. A student can be refunded only what they have paid ahead.
texts.ResumeDateHelp: When a deferred or suspended student is expected back.
texts.ApproveStatusChangeConfirmation: The student takes the new status. Graduation is approved only when every unit is passed and no fees are owed.
texts.PensionerMemberHelp: The member the pension arises from. The name, scheme and bank details are taken from the member when left blank.
texts.PayPeriodHelp: Any day of the month the pensions are for.
texts.PayrollTaxHelp: Withheld from the part of each pension above the tax free amount.
texts.PostPensionPayrollConfirmation: The payroll will be posted to pensions paid, tax and benefits payable.
texts.Erp:Academics:00033: Clash with {unit} on {day} at {time}: the {what} is already booked then.
texts.Erp:Academics:00034: {start} to {end} is not a valid time range: give the times as HH:mm, the end after the start.
texts.Erp:Academics:00035: Room {room} seats {capacity}, but {students} students are registered for the unit.
texts.Erp:Academics:00036: Student {studentNo} attended {pct}% of unit {unit}, below the {minimum}% needed to sit the final exam.

texts.Erp:Academics:00038: Room {room} of hostel {hostel} has no free bed space.

texts.Erp:Academics:00043: {documentNo} has the wrong number of participants: an individual application takes exactly one, a corporate one at least one and a sponsor, and no more than the course allows.
texts.Erp:Academics:00045: An exam of unit {unit} needs an exam date.
texts.Erp:Academics:00046: Only {inventory} of item {itemNo} are in stock; {quantity} are prescribed.

texts.Erp:Pensions:00028: Member {memberNo} has no {field}, which the pension is worked out from.
texts.Erp:Pensions:00029: Member {memberNo} would retire at {age}, below the scheme's minimum retirement age of {minimum}.
texts.Erp:Pensions:00030: {pct}% of the pension cannot be commuted: the scheme allows at most {maximum}%.
texts.Erp:Payroll:00001: Employee {employeeNo} would be paid {net}: the deductions are more than the pay.
texts.Erp:Payroll:00002: Payroll run {documentNo} is {status}, so this cannot be done to it.
texts.Erp:Payroll:00003: Payroll run {documentNo} has nothing to post or pay.

texts.ModuleDescription:Payroll: Earnings, deductions and income tax bands, employees' pay items, monthly payroll runs with payslips, posting to the ledger, net pay through payment vouchers, and the payroll reports.
texts.TimetableDayHelp: The weekday of a teaching session. An exam takes the weekday of its date.
texts.RoomCapacityHelp: The most students the room seats; a class larger than this cannot be timetabled in it. 0 is not checked.
texts.AttendanceMarkHelp: Late counts as attended; an excused absence is left out of the student's count.
texts.PostAttendanceConfirmation: Post the register? Each student's attendance count of the unit is updated and the register cannot be changed afterwards.
texts.MinAttendancePctHelp: A student who attended less of a unit's classes cannot be given a final exam mark. 0 does not check.
texts.HostelGenderHelp: The students the hostel houses; None takes either.
texts.CostPerOccupantHelp: What a place costs for a semester when its room has no cost of its own.
texts.RoomCostHelp: What a place in this room costs for a semester; 0 takes the hostel's cost per occupant.
texts.AllocateHostelConfirmation: Allocate the place? The student is billed for it and the bed space is taken.
texts.ClearRoomConfirmation: Clear the student out of the room? The bed space becomes free.
texts.PatientNoHelp: The student or employee number; their name is taken from the record.
texts.PatientNameHelp: Only for a patient who is neither a student nor an employee.
texts.ReferredToHelp: Where the patient was sent on to; the visit then completes as Referred.
texts.ClinicChargeHelp: Billed to a student's account when the visit is completed; nothing is billed to anyone else.
texts.CompleteVisitConfirmation: Complete the visit? The drugs prescribed are issued from stock and a student is billed the charge.
texts.PrescriptionItemHelp: The stock item dispensed. Leave blank for a drug prescribed but not dispensed here.
texts.MedicalFeeItemCodeHelp: The fee item infirmary charges are billed to students under.
texts.LaundryCustomerHelp: A student's account has the student's number.
texts.LaundryExpressHelp: An express order costs the Academic Setup's express charge more per item.
texts.InvoiceLaundryConfirmation: Invoice the order to the customer? It cannot be changed afterwards.
texts.MaxParticipantsHelp: The most participants one application may enrol; 0 is no limit.
texts.ShortCourseApplicationTypeHelp: An individual applies for themselves; a corporate application is one sponsor sending several participants.
texts.ShortCourseEndDateHelp: Blank runs the course for its duration from the start date.
texts.ShortCourseSponsorHelp: The customer billed for a corporate application. An individual applicant is given an account of their own on registration.
texts.RegisterParticipantsConfirmation: Register the participants? The fee is invoiced and certificate numbers are given.
texts.AccrualRateHelp: The share of final pensionable salary each year of service earns as annual pension, e.g. 2 for 1/50.
texts.CommutationFactorHelp: What one unit of annual pension given up is worth as a lump sum.
texts.EarlyRetirementReductionHelp: How much the pension is cut for each year a member retires before the normal retirement age.
texts.RetirementDateHelp: Blank takes the member's expected retirement date.
texts.FinalPensionableSalaryHelp: 0 takes twelve times the member's current monthly salary.
texts.CommutationPctHelp: The share of the annual pension the member gives up for a lump sum.
texts.ApproveBenefitCalculationConfirmation: Approve the calculation? The member becomes a pensioner on the monthly pension and a payment voucher is raised for the lump sum.
texts.PayrollSetupHelp: Payroll runs are numbered from this series. The personal relief is taken off every employee's monthly income tax.
texts.PersonalReliefHelp: Monthly; income tax never goes below zero.
texts.TopBandHelp: 0 is the top band, with no upper limit.
texts.PayDefaultValueHelp: A flat amount, or the percentage of basic or gross pay, for employees without an amount of their own.
texts.BasicPayHelp: The earning the others take percentages of; one earning should be it.
texts.MaximumAmountHelp: The most deducted in a month; 0 is no cap.
texts.StatutoryHelp: Deducted from every employee on the payroll, without a pay item each.
texts.TaxDeductibleHelp: Taken off pay before income tax is worked out, e.g. a registered pension contribution.
texts.EmployerContributionHelp: What the employer pays on top, as a percentage of what is deducted, e.g. 100 for a matched pension.
texts.PayItemCodeHelp: An earning or a deduction code, as the item type says.
texts.PayItemAmountHelp: 0 takes the earning's or deduction's own calculation.
texts.PostPayrollConfirmation: Post the payroll run? The pay is posted to the ledger and the employees' accounts, and the run cannot be calculated again.
texts.RaisePayrollVoucherConfirmation: Raise the payment voucher that pays each employee's net pay?
texts.Erp:Pensions:00031: The beneficiaries of member {memberNo} would have {total}% between them; their shares cannot add up to more than 100%.
texts.Erp:Pensions:00032: The beneficiaries of member {memberNo} have {total}% between them. Their shares must add up to 100% before a death benefit is approved.
texts.Erp:Pensions:00033: Sponsor {sponsorNo} already has contribution rates for part of this period.
texts.Erp:Pensions:00035: Pensioner {pensionerNo} is {status}, so the pension cannot be suspended.
texts.BenefitPctHelp: The share of the member's benefit this beneficiary receives. A member's active shares add up to at most 100%, and to exactly 100% before a death benefit is approved.
texts.GuardianNameHelp: Who receives the share while the beneficiary is under 18.
texts.ContributionRateEndHelp: Blank keeps these rates until a later rate starts. Schedules take the rates in force for their contribution period, and the sponsor's own rates when none is.
texts.FromServiceYearsHelp: The band applies from this many years of pensionable service until the next band starts.
texts.ApplyVestingScaleHelp: Vests the employer's money by the sponsor's vesting scale, for sponsors that have one, instead of the employer portion above. Usual for withdrawals.
texts.MonthlyLimitHelp: The most a member's contributions for one month can come to and still be registered (tax exempt). The rest is unregistered.
texts.ExcessContributionAllocationHelp: Which money uses the tax relief limit first: the employee's, or each side in proportion to its contribution rate.
texts.IncrementEffectiveHelp: Any day of the first month the new pensions are paid for. Months already paid from then on are owed as arrears.
texts.MinimumMonthlyPensionHelp: No pension is left below this after the increment. Zero sets no floor.
texts.ApplyIncrementConfirmation: Every pension of the scheme in payment on the effective date will be raised. This cannot be undone.
texts.LifeCertificateFrequencyHelp: How often a pensioner must prove they are alive. Zero never asks.
texts.RecordLifeCertificateConfirmation: A life certificate dated today will be recorded. A pension stopped because it was missing will be paid again, with the months missed as arrears.
texts.SuspendPensionConfirmation: The pension will not be paid until the pensioner is reinstated.
texts.ReinstatePensionConfirmation: The pension will be paid again. The months it was due but not paid will be owed as arrears and paid with the next payroll.
texts.SuspendOverduePensionersConfirmation: Every active pensioner of this scheme whose life certificate is overdue will be suspended.
texts.PayrollTaxTableHelp: Taxes each pension through the bands of this table, less the personal relief. Blank taxes at the flat rate.
texts.Erp:Pensions:00037: Exit {documentNo} cannot be approved until these documents have been received: {documents}.
texts.Erp:Pensions:00038: The deductions of pensioner {pensionerNo} on {documentNo} ({deductions}) come to more than the pension left after tax ({available}).
texts.Erp:Pensions:00039: Branch {branchCode} is not a branch of bank {bankCode}.
texts.Erp:Pensions:00040: Pay item {code} is given to pensioners, so it cannot be deleted. Block it instead.
texts.FactorTypeHelp: Early and late retirement factors multiply the pension of a member retiring at that age; commutation factors value each unit of pension given up for a lump sum. A factor holds until the next age in the table.
texts.LifeCertificateReasonHelp: Suspending overdue pensioners uses this reason, and receiving a life certificate pays the pension again.
texts.MandatoryDocumentHelp: An exit cannot be approved until a mandatory document has been received.
texts.PayItemAccountHelp: Debited with an earning (blank uses the Pensions Paid account) or credited with a deduction (required).
texts.PayItemPctHelp: For the percentage calculation: the share of the month's pension.
texts.PayItemTaxableHelp: An earning that is taxed with the pension, or a deduction taken off the pension before it is taxed.
texts.PensionerPayItemAmountHelp: The amount for pensioners given the item without an amount of their own.
texts.AssignmentAmountHelp: The pensioner's own amount, or percentage for a percentage item; zero takes the item's.
texts.PayModeCodeHelp: Blank takes the default pay mode of the Pension Setup.
texts.PayrollLineMonthlyPensionHelp: The pension for the month, without arrears or earnings. Blank takes the pensioner's monthly pension.
texts.PensionableSalaryBasisHelp: The salary a calculation uses when none is keyed in, read from the member's salary history.
texts.PensionerBankCodeHelp: The bank's and branch's names replace the bank name and branch below.
texts.ReceivedDateHelp: Blank on a received document is today.
texts.TransferSchemeCodeHelp: Transfers in only: the scheme the members' money comes from.
texts.TrivialPensionLimitHelp: A monthly pension below this is paid as a lump sum instead. Zero pays every pension monthly.
